title: Integral and rational homomorphisms of abelian varieties
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and $A,B$ abelian varieties over $k$ [def-sc-abelian-variety]. Write $\operatorname{Hom}_k(A,B)$ for the group-scheme homomorphisms [def-sc-group-scheme], with addition induced by the group law of $B$, and $\operatorname{Hom}^0_k(A,B)=\mathbf Q\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\operatorname{Hom}_k(A,B)$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product], canonically identified by tensor symmetry with $\operatorname{Hom}_k(A,B)\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$. The canonical rationalization sends $f$ to $1\otimes f$. Integral composition is composition of group-scheme morphisms and its identity is the identity morphism.

source.place: I §10 Hom groups, and §14 opening p.61: Hom^0 and End tensor Q.
